sections.label: Silver Zones and Friendly Streets
sections.summary: No additional Silver Zones are planned beyond the 50; the Friendly Streets initiative will expand to all towns by 2030.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Acting Minister of State for Transport)
sentences.text: Beyond the completion of the planned 50 Silver Zones island-wide, there are currently no plans to designate additional Silver Zones.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Acting Minister of State for Transport)
sentences.text: In its place, we have launched the Friendly Streets initiative.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Acting Minister of State for Transport)
sentences.text: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) will continue to make commutes in our neighbourhoods safer, more convenient and comfortable for all by expanding the Friendly Streets initiative to all towns by 2030.

sections.label: Friendly Streets near amenities
sections.summary: Five Friendly Street projects were completed in Toa Payoh, Ang Mo Kio, West Coast, Bukit Batok West and Tampines, with average vehicular speeds dropping about 20%.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: So, for instance, near hawker centres, near markets, near Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) stations, near community clubs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: We have completed five Friendly Street projects earlier this year in Toa Payoh, Ang Mo Kio, West Coast, Bukit Batok West and Tampines.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Average vehicular speeds at these Friendly Streets have dropped by about 20% and this contributes toward pedestrian safety.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: On her second question, indeed, under the Friendly Streets initiative, we could incorporate elements, such as signalised pedestrian crossing, kerbless crossing, reduce speed limits.

sections.label: Expanding Friendly Streets to towns
sections.summary: Friendly Streets will expand to all towns by 2030, launched in high pedestrian flow areas, with more areas including Nee Soon South to be identified.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: As I have shared earlier, we will expand the Friendly Streets initiatives to all towns by 2030.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: And within each town, the Friendly Streets initiatives will be launched in areas with high pedestrian flow and close to amenities.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: And I have heard her feedback, so we will continue to identify more areas to implement Friendly Streets and also, potentially, Nee Soon South, as suggested by Ms Lee.
